create_CacheRenamingMigration: create a CacheRenamingMigration to rename cache_kind entries from old to new value in MongoDB cache collection
create_QueueRenamingMigration: create a QueueRenamingMigration to rename job_type and unicity_id fields in MongoDB jobs collection
run_CacheRenamingMigration_up: run the up method of CacheRenamingMigration to update cache entries with the new cache kind
run_QueueRenamingMigration_up: run the up method of QueueRenamingMigration to update job type and unicity_id fields in jobs collection
run_CacheRenamingMigration_validate: run the validate method of CacheRenamingMigration to verify modified cache documents
